name: io.github.loopg/pramana-mcp
description: Read your recorded AI agent runs, and what changed when you swapped a model or prompt.

environmentVariables.name: PRAMANA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: A Pramana engineer or admin API key, from Settings -> API keys at https://www.reliai.in/. An auditor key never receives recorded prompts or responses, so reads would come back empty.

environmentVariables.name: PRAMANA_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Pramana API. Only set this if you are self-hosting; it defaults to the hosted API.
